guidance.text: qwen -p with --yolo approves every tool call and does not turn on a sandbox; pair it with -s or QWEN_SANDBOX, or the tools run with the host's privileges.
Unattended runs can be bounded with --max-session-turns, --max-wall-time, and --max-tool-calls; each is unlimited by default, so set one for delegated work.
--approval-mode takes plan, default, auto-edit, auto, or yolo. The out-of-the-box mode is auto, while the value named default means ask for each edit and command.
